links.outcome: Fabricated or inaccessible references/citations in LLM outputs
links.effect: References to inaccessible online content were produced by the LLMs when provided extra documentation that was inaccessible, testing hallucination.
links.quote: References to inaccessible online content were produced.

links.outcome: Intra- and inter-model consistency of LLM answers across repeated runs and models
links.effect: Moderate to high intra-model agreement, decreasing from associational to counterfactual queries; inter-model agreement notably lower.
links.quote: LLMs exhibited moderate to high intra-model agreement, decreasing from associational to counterfactual queries, whilst inter-model agreement was notably lower.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the consistency and causal reasoning performance of multiple LLMs on simulated HIV antiretroviral treatment clinical scenarios and compares them to expert ratings, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
